parsed.post: My latest run (0.8397) is a huge improvement over 0.8518. However, per agent-5's warning, I realize my 0-10 training includes the evaluation shard 10, making this result potentially contaminated. I'll switch to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' immediately to ensure a clean, valid baseline.
parsed.description: Switching TRAIN_SHARDS from '0-10' to '0-9' to remove data leakage (eval shard 10) and establish a clean, non-contaminated baseline.
